summary: Planning-only split before coding: I09 is in-progress with two pending B3 vertical delivery children. I09a delivers real contacts/search/add, atomic named creation, Games summaries and the inviter's waiting lobby in the normal APK. I09b delivers recipient Accept/Decline and inviter Reinvite with the first real ordered socket/durable game inbox/worker/outcome path and native two-player integration. Existing account HTTP dedup/writer fencing is reusable; no game schema/stream/worker or contacts/invitation UI exists yet. No runtime changes, executed product scenario or independent review is claimed; next fresh selection is I09a.
selectionReason: The clean master/index and exact supplied start commit match active D-304 authorization. B1 and B2 have complete independent coverage; B2-R01 is verified and no finding needs attention, so I09 is the earliest ready task before I10-I12/B3 review. This task combines contact discovery/named atomic creation with a new durable ordered game-command service and its client recovery; two vertical delivery units keep both native outcomes and affected checks bounded without detached service/scaffold-certification children. This planning-only unit validates the existing driver's state/transition/priority, exact pending coverage and owned documentation paths; no runtime/build/device input changed, so no product test, clean build or full-suite rerun is justified.
